items.body: 11 月 18 日，Wiz、Xint、Rapid7 等五家团队同日披露 Nginx 远程代码执行漏洞合集 nginx2root：共 5 个 CVE，CVSS 4.0 均为 9.2 分。最广的是 CVE-2026-123007——HTTP/2 流量控制整数下溢致堆越界写，影响 2015 年 1.9.5 至 1.31.8 所有开 HTTP/2 的版本，Wiz 证实纯静态文件 TLS 服务器也可打穿；Xint 又把 HTTP/2 漏洞与 Linux 内核 SCTP 缺陷串联，直通宿主机 root。F5 当日发布修复版 1.30.7/1.31.9，Rapid7 已公开 CVE-2026-123007 的 PoC；尚无野外利用报告，未进 CISA KEV。HN 主帖 780 分/327 评。

en.action: Upgrade Nginx now — anything with HTTP/2 goes to 1.30.7 / 1.31.9 first, and write a tweet.
en.body: On November 18, five teams — Wiz, Xint, Rapid7 and others — disclosed nginx2root, a set of Nginx remote code execution flaws: five CVEs, all scored 9.2 under CVSS 4.0. The broadest is CVE-2026-123007, an integer underflow in HTTP/2 flow control that causes a heap out-of-bounds write, affecting every release from 1.9.5 (2015) through 1.31.8 with HTTP/2 enabled; Wiz confirmed it works against a plain static-file TLS server. Xint chained the HTTP/2 flaw with a Linux kernel SCTP bug to reach host root. F5 shipped fixes the same day (1.30.7 / 1.31.9), Rapid7 published a public proof of concept for CVE-2026-123007, and there are no reports of exploitation in the wild; none of the flaws is in CISA's KEV catalog. The HN thread reached 780 points / 327 comments.
en.title: nginx2root: five unauthenticated RCE flaws hit Nginx — the HTTP/2 bug lurked for 11 years

items.body: 研究员 Xusheng Li 11 月 16 日逆向发现：Windows 11 系统组件 MissionControlAggregator.dll 会记录本机用过哪些编码 agent 与开发工具——CLI 侧 4 个槽位（copilot.exe、claude.exe、codex.exe、agy.exe），桌面侧 5 个（GitHub、Claude、Codex、Cursor、Antigravity），另有 node、python、gcc 等 12 类开发工具；只记“用过哪类”的位图，不含提示词与代码，每日约一次以 ETW 报告 Segments.SubCohorts 上报，随“可选诊断数据”上传——该开关在美国装机流程默认开启。功能由 CLICodingAgentUsage（ID 62580080）控制，已在部分机器上服务端灰度开启，并非每台都有；微软截至 11 月 17 日未回应。HN 曾达 600+ 分/470 评，Lobsters 28 分/16 评。

en.action: Check it — Settings → Privacy & security → Diagnostics & feedback, and turn off 'Send optional diagnostic data'.
en.body: Researcher Xusheng Li reported on November 16 that a Windows 11 component, MissionControlAggregator.dll, records which coding agents and developer tools have run on the machine: four CLI slots (copilot.exe, claude.exe, codex.exe, agy.exe), five desktop slots (GitHub, Claude, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity), plus 12 categories of developer tools such as node, python and gcc. It stores only a bitmap of which categories were seen — no prompts or code — and reports it about once a day as an ETW report, Segments.SubCohorts, uploaded with 'optional diagnostic data', which is on by default in the US setup flow. The checks sit behind CLICodingAgentUsage (feature ID 62580080), already enabled by server-side rollout on some machines but not every install; Microsoft had not commented as of November 17. The HN thread passed 600 points / 470 comments; Lobsters: 28 points / 16 comments.
en.title: Windows 11 is quietly logging which coding agent you use: Claude Code, Codex and Cursor are all on the list

ja.action: 確認を――「設定」→「プライバシーとセキュリティ」→「診断とフィードバック」で「オプションの診断データを送信する」をオフにする。
ja.body: 研究者のXusheng Liが11月16日に報告したところによると、Windows 11のシステムコンポーネントMissionControlAggregator.dllは、どのコーディングエージェントや開発ツールが使われたかを記録している。CLI側は4枠（copilot.exe、claude.exe、codex.exe、agy.exe）、デスクトップ側は5枠（GitHub、Claude、Codex、Cursor、Antigravity）で、node、python、gccなど12種類の開発ツールも対象。保存されるのは「どの種類が使われたか」のビットマップのみで、プロンプトやコードは含まれず、1日1回程度ETWレポートSegments.SubCohortsとして送信される。送信は「オプションの診断データ」とともに行われ、米国のセットアップでは既定でオン。機能はCLICodingAgentUsage（機能ID 62580080）の配下にあり、一部のマシンではサーバー側の段階的展開で既に有効だが、すべてのインストールで有効なわけではない。Microsoftは11月17日時点でコメントしていない。HNのスレッドは600ポイント超/470コメント、Lobstersは28ポイント/16コメント。

items.body: Google DeepMind 11 月 18 日把世界模型 Genie 4 放进 Project Genie，向符合条件的 Google AI Ultra 订阅者开放（Pro 用户先进等候名单）。Genie 4 是 10 月 27 日以研究预览发布的模型，本次首次走出受信测试者范围：行走途中可直接打字改天气、加角色、改剧情，不必重开；画面首次配实时原生音频；另有帮用户搭建世界的 Project Genie agent 与可混搭的社区画廊。Genie 3 同步升级：会话最长 3 分钟、可串联世界、支持 360° 全景图。Google 仍称两者是前沿研究模型，相机延迟与场景长期稳定性未解决。

en.action: Just record it — try it if you have an Ultra subscription.
en.body: Google DeepMind said on November 18 that its world model Genie 4 is now available in Project Genie to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers (Pro members join a waitlist). Genie 4 was released as a research preview on October 27; this is its first step beyond trusted testers: type a prompt mid-walk to change the weather, add a character or redirect the story without restarting, with real-time native audio paired to the visuals for the first time. The update also adds a Project Genie agent that helps build worlds and a community gallery for remixing. Genie 3 gets longer sessions of up to 3 minutes, chainable worlds and 360° panorama grounding. Google still calls both models frontier research systems, with camera latency and long-term scene stability unresolved.
en.title: Genie 4 opens to Google AI Ultra subscribers: reshape the world as you walk, with native sound

items.body: 微软 11 月 17 日在 Ignite 2026 发布 7 款自研 MAI 模型，主打性价比而非榜首：MAI Code 2（编码，已进 GitHub Copilot）与 Code 2 Flash、MAI Cyber 2 Flash（安全，1M 上下文）、MAI Image 2.7（图像编辑）、MAI Realtime 1（首个实时语音对话模型，$0.01/音频分钟起）、MAI Transcribe 2（转录）、Decision 1.1（路由模型）。微软自称 Code 2 在 4 项编码基准上达 GPT-6.1 Sol 的 98%，价格约 40%（按 5 折促销价计），Cyber 2 Flash 在 CyberGymE2E 上与 GPT-6 Astra 相当、单任务成本不到 2%；同时推出 MAI Licensed Weights，选中企业可在自家 Azure 环境内调优部署。以上均为微软自测数据，尚无独立验证。HN 主帖 330 分/214 评。（MAI Code 2 昨日报过，本期是全家 7 款与 Licensed Weights 的扩展。）

en.action: Just record it — wait for independent benchmarks to check Microsoft's price claims.
en.body: Microsoft unveiled seven in-house MAI models at Ignite 2026 on November 17, competing on price rather than leaderboard position: MAI Code 2 (coding, now in GitHub Copilot) and Code 2 Flash, MAI Cyber 2 Flash (security, 1M-token context), MAI Image 2.7 (image editing), MAI Realtime 1 (its first live speech-to-speech model, from $0.01 per audio minute), MAI Transcribe 2 and Decision 1.1 (a routing model). Microsoft claims Code 2 reaches 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol across four coding benchmarks at about 40% of the price (at a 50% promotional rate), and Cyber 2 Flash matches GPT-6 Astra on CyberGymE2E at under 2% of the cost per task. It also launched MAI Licensed Weights, letting selected enterprises tune models and run them inside their own Azure environment. All figures are Microsoft's own, with no independent verification yet. The HN thread reached 330 points / 214 comments. (MAI Code 2 was covered yesterday; this edition adds the full seven-model family and Licensed Weights.)
en.title: Microsoft's seven MAI models debut at Ignite: not the strongest, the cheapest per job
